text:
Priya: dropped a small idea in Figma: compact legend with compare mode toggle (frame: compact-legend-compare). Questions: where to put the compare toggle in tight headers, how to label it for clarity, and any a11y/copy nits. link: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-legend-compare

Jon: quick glance 50d My instinct: put the toggle next to the legend title as a tiny segmented control: `Values | Compare`. Keep icons minimal. When enabled, the legend should show delta arrows and a short tooltip explaining baseline.

Ravi: accessibility: toggle must be a real button with aria-pressed or a radiogroup. Screen reader text should read the baseline source, e.g., `Compare to: previous period`. Also consider a visual affordance for colorblind users (delta arrow + +/- sign).

Maya: copy nits: `Compare` alone is vague. Options: `Compare to baseline`, `Compare (previous)`, `Show delta`. I prefer `Compare to baseline` with a hover tooltip: `Shows change vs selected baseline`. Tooltip <= 60 chars.

Priya: placement tension: header is crowded. alternatives: small chevron icon next to legend title that opens a micro-popover with options (off / previous period / custom baseline). That keeps UI compact. Thoughts?

Jon: popover is good. make keyboard accessible: open with Enter/Space on icon; arrow keys to pick baseline. Also show the sampled `n=` in the popover so users see context.

Ravi: visual treatment: when compare mode is on, add a subtle background strip behind the delta numbers and use a dashed baseline line in the chart. Provide an opt-in high-contrast pattern for the delta overlay for a11y.

Maya: animation: when toggling compare, animate delta bars with a 120ms fade+translate so values don't jump. Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Also add an ephemeral toast: `Compare to previous period enabled` with role=status.

DesignerBot: accessibility scan: recommended aria patterns:
1) Use a button with aria-expanded for popover trigger: `aria-label="Compare legend options"`
2) For options list use role=listbox + aria-activedescendant
3) Announce change via polite aria-live: `Compare to previous period enabled; sample size n=123`
Contrast: delta arrows on small chips must maintain 4.5:1 when text is present.

Priya: thanks all. plan:
- implement popover trigger (icon) next to legend title
- default options: Off / Previous period / Custom baseline
- label: `Compare to baseline` + tooltip `Shows change vs selected baseline`
- keyboard nav + aria patterns per DesignerBot
- small animation (120ms) + reduce-motion respect
- delta visual: dashed baseline + background strip + optional pattern for a11y
I'll update the figma and ping when ready. :sparkles:
